answer: Rate-limited arrival lanes: each new identity must enter through a lane paced to live-load spiral; burst clusters are held until timing matches organic joins. Clustered identities wait on a shared jetty before admission. Each identity’s first requests replay through a delayed mirror, so clones cannot hide behind identical timing. An attacker pays full queue delay plus separate jitter/egress per identity, so N sybils cost N slow lanes, not one burst.
